reproduction.method: Separate stabilized least squares versus empirical common-mean Gaussian MAP slopes
reproduction.description: Vary sample size in related and heterogeneous task populations while keeping task intercepts separate.
differences: Seeded synthetic 1D linear tasks follow the original educational setup; 10 tasks and N=4,8,16,32 replace the D=1/50,T=5/25 sweeps.
Known fixed noise/prior precision substitutes for per-task residual-variance estimation; no mixture clustering of tasks.
One seeded run compares related and heterogeneous slopes; reported MSE is against noiseless functions, not fabricated multi-seed confidence intervals.
